flaws_cloud.title: flaws.cloud CloudTrail logs (Summit Route, 2020)
flaws_cloud.license: No license stated by the source. Published by Summit Route (Scott Piper) as a public research dataset; the site footer reads 'All Rights Reserved'. Fetch from the source, do not redistribute.
flaws_cloud.integrity: The source publishes no checksum. The archive SHA-256 was pinned on first download (trust on first use); members are hashed from that verified archive.

invictus_sigma_aws.title: Invictus IR Sigma-AWS: CloudTrail from Stratus Red Team simulations (2023)
invictus_sigma_aws.license: MIT, Copyright (c) 2023 Invictus Incident Response (repository LICENSE file)
invictus_sigma_aws.integrity: Pinned to a git commit. Every file was verified against its git blob SHA-1 at that commit before its SHA-256 was recorded.

splunk_attack_data.title: Splunk attack_data: CloudTrail samples per ATT&CK technique
splunk_attack_data.integrity: Pinned to a git commit. The files are Git LFS objects; every download was verified against the SHA-256 and size in its LFS pointer at that commit.
splunk_attack_data.selection: Files whose dataset descriptor (YAML) declares sourcetype 'aws:cloudtrail' and whose every record has eventID, eventName, eventSource and eventTime. Byte-identical duplicates are kept once. Everything else is listed under 'excluded' with the reason.
